text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The final day of summer camp. Biwa 
Hayahide had grown so much she was 
practically unrecognizable compared to 
before.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I thought she had gained confidence as 
well, but...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Scared of Ticket more than anyone else, 
huh?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Those two just keep pulling further and 
further away... ...leaving me behind...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gazing at the massive thunderclouds, she 
murmurs, as though she still harbors 
lingering regrets.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...I felt that in order to give her a 
push forward, one more catalyst would be 
needed."
